title: Not perfected but, definitely an option that can work!!
text:
Not perfected but, definitely an option that can work!!. Photos are a bit misleading showing a plump, oversized air filled mattress!! Trying to fill this ourselves without a breeze proved difficult at best.. it took 3 adults and 15min. of trying to only obtain 70% fill capacity- A bit of a letdown since I gabe this as a gift!!

This has a nice tropical print that is great coloring when in the suns heat. This won’t absorb direct sunshine and become too hot to touch… Size is far bigger than we ever expected easily shared by 2 people if desired. A bit odd in shape especially if it’s not filled up fully- (ok, imagine a basking shark with its big gulping mouth.. this is a lot like that. Flap/mouth must be moving into wind or Vice versa- it’s big air pocket opening that catches air and traps it.. Best way I can think to describe!) This will lose air through the “roll + close off with a clamp” mechanism- prob. needing refill between 20-45 min. Depending on how much air you start with/how much weight is utilizing it- these both play active role in maintaining air.

This is an amphibian but, I wouldnt personally use on the water.. simply because wants to deflate on its own and nothing is 100% secure. If I’m h2o- I wouldn’t recommend for children and I’d only use in a pool if I can stand touching the bottom!

TBH, I see this used on camping trips or, being left in a trunk to use at a ball game when seating is limited- it’s a fun idea for extra seating in a college dorm room.. any place impromptu seating may be necessary! It isn’t full proof but, definitely better than the hard ground alternative. The issue is inflating on a non-windy day.. and in the situation as it takes patience and the buddy system! Overall- not perfected but, definitely an option. Hoping this info can help you in your decision- stay safe!
